page.layout: One printed page, text in one column on the left part of the scan; the right side is cut off. Faint show-through from the reverse side runs through the text and is not transcribed. No margin notes.; One column of index text, with the top line running across the page; centred letter headings C., D., E., F.; drop-capital initials at the left of each group of entries.

page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off; the lines are cut at the right edge, so entries such as "Petrus à Beeck Canonicus A-quisgr." and "Georgius Buchanamus" are read as far as visible. Some words are doubtful because of show-through. Page number at the foot appears as "ꝯ ꝯ (9)" and is not reliably readable. Drop capitals I, P, E, F are decorative initials; the initial I of the C group reads as "Iul.Cæsar." with the large letter joined. The line "Alexand." at the foot is a catchword-like entry and was read as printed. Some marginal ink and show-through on the left are not transcribed.
